snippet.title: The Settlers Collection: Gamescom 2018 Trailer | Ubisoft [NA]
snippet.description:
Celebrating the 25th Anniversary of the The Settlers series all 7 games will be available as HISTORY EDITIONS with the complete content including all expansions as improved versions and optimized for modern PC systems. Get the bundle, THE SETTLERS HISTORY COLLECTION, exclusively available via Uplay.
#TheSettlers #Gamescom2018

More details: https://store.ubi.com/ca/the-settlers-collection/5964e4760c8ee45b738b456c.html?lang=en
